name: Claude
description: Anthropic's AI assistant known for strong reasoning, long-context understanding, and safety-focused design, available through claude.ai web interface, mobile apps, and API with features like Projects, Artifacts, and Claude Code.

writing-chat.summary: Claude excels at conversational writing with nuanced, well-structured responses, supporting Projects for organized workspaces, Artifacts for rich content creation, and customizable system prompts for tailored behavior.

subFeatures.name: Projects
subFeatures.description: Organized workspaces that group conversations with shared instructions and knowledge files, enabling consistent context across related chats

subFeatures.name: Artifacts
subFeatures.description: Interactive side panel for generating and editing documents, code, SVGs, React components, and Mermaid diagrams alongside the conversation

subFeatures.name: System Prompts
subFeatures.description: Customizable project-level instructions that shape Claude's behavior, tone, and response format across all conversations in a project

subFeatures.name: Multi-turn Conversations
subFeatures.description: Extended conversation threads with ability to branch, edit previous messages, and maintain coherent long-form dialogue

subFeatures.name: Model Selection
subFeatures.description: Switch between Claude Opus 4, Sonnet 4, and Haiku models based on task complexity and speed requirements

limitations: 200K token context window (largest among major chatbots but still finite)
Free tier limited to Sonnet with lower rate limits
No equivalent to ChatGPT's Custom Instructions for non-project conversations on free tier
Response length can be conservative without explicit instruction to be thorough

pricingTiers.details: Claude Sonnet with rate limits, basic Artifacts, no Projects
Opus 4, Sonnet 4, Haiku, Projects, higher rate limits, priority access
Pro features plus team workspace, admin controls, 500K context for select models
SSO/SCIM, audit logs, custom data retention, dedicated capacity

versionHistory.changes: Most capable model with extended thinking, superior reasoning and coding
Balanced model with strong coding and instruction following
Major quality upgrade in coding, analysis, and instruction following
First Opus-tier model with near-human reasoning

research.summary: Claude supports web search for current information retrieval with source citations, though research capabilities are more recent additions compared to its core analysis strengths.

subFeatures.name: Web Search
subFeatures.description: Real-time web search integrated into conversations to find current information, with inline source citations

subFeatures.name: Source Citations
subFeatures.description: Inline references to web sources with clickable links when web search is used

subFeatures.name: Document-Based Research
subFeatures.description: Analyze uploaded documents, extract key findings, compare sources, and synthesize information across multiple files within Projects

limitations: Web search is a newer feature with less refinement than competitors
Cannot access paywalled or login-gated content
No dedicated multi-step autonomous research agent comparable to ChatGPT Deep Research
Free tier has limited or no web search access

pricingTiers.details: No web search, document analysis only
Web search with citations, document-based research
Full research capabilities with data controls

versionHistory.changes: Real-time web search integration with source citations
Multi-document analysis and synthesis capabilities

file-analysis.summary: Claude can analyze uploaded files including PDFs, images, code files, CSVs, and text documents, with strong performance on long documents due to its 200K token context window.

subFeatures.name: PDF Analysis
subFeatures.description: Read and analyze PDF documents including complex layouts, tables, and embedded images, leveraging the full 200K context window

subFeatures.name: Vision / Image Analysis
subFeatures.description: Analyze uploaded images including photographs, diagrams, charts, screenshots, and handwritten content using Claude's native vision capabilities

subFeatures.name: Code File Analysis
subFeatures.description: Read, explain, debug, and refactor code files with support for all major programming languages

subFeatures.name: Spreadsheet and CSV Analysis
subFeatures.description: Parse and analyze tabular data from CSV and spreadsheet files, perform calculations, and identify patterns

subFeatures.name: Multi-File Analysis
subFeatures.description: Upload multiple files to a Project's knowledge base for cross-document analysis and comparison

limitations: No sandboxed code execution environment (cannot run code on uploaded data)
Cannot process video or audio files
File uploads limited to approximately 30 MB per file
Image analysis is input-only — cannot generate or edit images
Complex spreadsheet formulas and macros not interpreted

pricingTiers.details: Basic file uploads with rate-limited analysis
Higher file limits, Project knowledge bases, priority analysis
Largest file handling, data retention controls

versionHistory.changes: Improved image understanding and chart analysis accuracy
Native vision capabilities for image analysis
Direct PDF upload and analysis support

document-creation.summary: Claude generates documents, code, and visual content through Artifacts — an interactive side panel that renders markdown, HTML, React components, SVG graphics, and Mermaid diagrams as live previews.

subFeatures.name: Artifact Documents
subFeatures.description: Generate well-formatted documents rendered as live previews in the Artifacts panel, supporting markdown with tables, headers, and lists

subFeatures.name: Code Artifacts
subFeatures.description: Generate standalone code files displayed in a syntax-highlighted editor within the Artifacts panel, copyable and downloadable

subFeatures.name: SVG Graphics
subFeatures.description: Create and render SVG illustrations and diagrams directly in the Artifacts panel as live visual previews

subFeatures.name: Mermaid Diagrams
subFeatures.description: Generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and other Mermaid-based visualizations rendered as interactive diagrams

limitations: No direct export to Word, PowerPoint, or Google Docs
Artifacts are tied to conversations — no standalone sharing URL for documents
Cannot create multi-page documents with pagination
No collaborative real-time editing with other users
SVG output quality limited compared to dedicated design tools

pricingTiers.details: Basic Artifacts for documents and code
Full Artifact capabilities with higher limits
All document creation features with admin controls

versionHistory.changes: Interactive side panel for documents, code, SVGs, and Mermaid diagrams
Improved structured document formatting in Claude 3

image-generation.summary: Claude cannot generate raster images. It can create SVG graphics and diagrams through Artifacts but has no equivalent to DALL-E or Imagen for photorealistic or artistic image generation.

subFeatures.name: SVG Generation (via Artifacts)
subFeatures.description: Create vector graphics, icons, and simple illustrations as SVG code rendered in the Artifacts panel — not equivalent to AI image generation

limitations: No AI image generation capability (no DALL-E equivalent)
SVG generation limited to simple vector graphics and diagrams
Cannot edit, modify, or enhance uploaded images
No planned image generation feature announced

pricingTiers.details: SVG generation via Artifacts available on all tiers; no raster image generation on any tier

versionHistory.changes: SVG rendering support added through Artifacts panel

prototyping.summary: Claude supports interactive prototyping through Artifacts, which can render live React components, HTML/CSS/JS applications, and interactive visualizations directly in the browser, making it uniquely strong for front-end prototyping.

subFeatures.name: React Component Artifacts
subFeatures.description: Generate and render fully interactive React components with state management, event handling, and Tailwind CSS styling in a live preview

subFeatures.name: HTML/CSS/JS Artifacts
subFeatures.description: Create complete web pages and interactive applications rendered live in the Artifacts panel

subFeatures.name: Interactive Data Visualizations
subFeatures.description: Build interactive charts and dashboards using libraries like Recharts or D3 within React Artifacts

subFeatures.name: Iterative Refinement
subFeatures.description: Modify Artifacts through conversation, making incremental changes while preserving the live preview

limitations: React Artifacts limited to single-file components (no multi-file projects)
Limited library availability — only select npm packages pre-installed in Artifact sandbox
No backend code execution (server-side logic, database access)
Cannot deploy or share prototypes as standalone applications
No mobile-responsive preview mode

pricingTiers.details: Basic Artifacts with React and HTML rendering
Higher rate limits for complex prototyping sessions
Full prototyping with admin controls

versionHistory.changes: Live React component rendering with Tailwind CSS in Artifacts panel
Interactive HTML/CSS/JS rendering in Artifacts

personalization.summary: Claude offers personalization through Project-level custom instructions that shape behavior for specific workspaces, though it lacks ChatGPT-style global Custom Instructions and cross-conversation memory on the free tier.

subFeatures.name: Project Instructions
subFeatures.description: Custom system prompts set at the Project level that apply to all conversations within that project, defining Claude's persona, rules, and response style

subFeatures.name: Conversation Styles
subFeatures.description: Users can set preferred response styles and adjust Claude's tone and verbosity through conversation-level instructions

subFeatures.name: Profile Preferences
subFeatures.description: Account-level settings for default response behavior and preferred communication style

limitations: No cross-conversation memory system (unlike ChatGPT Memory)
Project Instructions require Pro tier — free users rely on per-conversation context
No user profile that persists facts and preferences automatically
Cannot create shareable custom personas (no equivalent to Custom GPTs)

pricingTiers.details: Per-conversation instructions only
Project Instructions, profile preferences
Admin-managed instruction templates across teams

versionHistory.changes: Custom system prompts for Project workspaces
Account-level default behavior settings

persistent-context.summary: Claude provides persistent context through Projects, which combine custom instructions with uploaded knowledge files to create reusable workspaces with consistent context across multiple conversations.

subFeatures.name: Project Knowledge Bases
subFeatures.description: Upload documents, code files, and data to a Project that are accessible across all conversations in that workspace, up to 200K tokens of context

subFeatures.name: Conversation History
subFeatures.description: All conversations are saved with full history, searchable and resumable from the sidebar

subFeatures.name: Starred Conversations
subFeatures.description: Pin important conversations for quick access and organization within the conversation list

limitations: No cross-conversation memory that automatically remembers facts (unlike ChatGPT Memory)
Project knowledge limited by context window size
Knowledge files must be manually uploaded — no automatic ingestion from URLs or feeds
Projects not available on free tier
No team-shared knowledge base across projects

pricingTiers.details: Conversation history and search only
Projects with knowledge bases, starred conversations
Shared team projects with knowledge bases
Advanced knowledge management, data retention controls

versionHistory.changes: Workspace-based persistent context with knowledge bases and custom instructions
Saved conversation history with search in Claude 3 launch

agents.summary: Claude offers powerful agentic capabilities through Claude Code (autonomous software engineering agent), computer use (GUI interaction), and API-based tool use for building custom agent workflows.

subFeatures.name: Claude Code
subFeatures.description: Terminal-based agentic coding assistant that can autonomously navigate codebases, write and edit files, run tests, and execute multi-step software engineering tasks

subFeatures.name: Computer Use (API)
subFeatures.description: Claude can interact with desktop GUIs by viewing screenshots and executing mouse/keyboard actions, enabling automation of visual software workflows

subFeatures.name: Tool Use (API)
subFeatures.description: Function-calling capability that lets Claude invoke external tools, APIs, and services as part of structured agent workflows via the API

subFeatures.name: Extended Thinking
subFeatures.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning mode where Claude shows its thinking process for complex multi-step problems before providing an answer

limitations: Computer use is API-only, not available in claude.ai interface
Claude Code requires separate setup and API credits or Pro subscription
No browser-based agent comparable to ChatGPT Operator in claude.ai
Tool use requires API integration — not a no-code solution
Computer use is still in beta with reliability limitations

pricingTiers.details: No agent capabilities
Claude Code included, Extended Thinking
Computer use and tool use billed per token
Full agent suite with admin controls and dedicated capacity

versionHistory.changes: General availability of agentic coding assistant with Opus 4
Chain-of-thought reasoning for complex problems
Desktop GUI interaction via screenshots and mouse/keyboard control
Function calling and structured tool integration via API

connectors.summary: Claude pioneered the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard for connecting AI models to external data sources and tools, and supports integrations with Google Drive, GitHub, and other services through MCP servers.

subFeatures.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
subFeatures.description: Open protocol created by Anthropic that standardizes how AI models connect to external tools, data sources, and services through a client-server architecture

subFeatures.name: Google Workspace Integration
subFeatures.description: Connect Claude to Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets for direct file access and analysis within conversations

subFeatures.name: GitHub Integration
subFeatures.description: Connect to GitHub repositories for code review, issue analysis, and codebase understanding

subFeatures.name: MCP Servers for Claude Code
subFeatures.description: Claude Code supports MCP servers for connecting to databases, APIs, and development tools during agentic coding sessions

limitations: MCP ecosystem still maturing — fewer pre-built connectors than competitors
Google Workspace integration requires separate authorization
No native Slack, Notion, or project management tool integration in claude.ai
MCP server setup requires technical knowledge
Enterprise connectors require custom deployment

pricingTiers.details: No connector capabilities
Google Workspace integration, MCP with Claude Code
GitHub integration, team-managed connectors
Custom MCP deployments, admin-managed integrations

versionHistory.changes: Open-source Model Context Protocol specification released
Native Google Workspace file access in claude.ai
Repository integration for Team and Enterprise tiers

dictation.summary: Claude does not offer native voice input or speech-to-text dictation. Users must type or paste text. Third-party integrations or OS-level dictation tools can be used as workarounds.

subFeatures.name: No Native Voice Input
subFeatures.description: Claude lacks built-in speech-to-text or voice mode — all input must be typed or pasted into the text interface

limitations: No voice input capability in claude.ai web or mobile apps
No text-to-speech output for responses
No real-time voice conversation mode
Users must rely on OS-level dictation (e.g., Windows speech recognition, macOS Dictation) as a workaround

pricingTiers.details: No dictation feature available on any tier

versionHistory.changes: No voice or dictation features have been released as of this date
